summary: The present R-6 flat-top cab on a 67-foot timber tower dates from 1961, replacing a 1923 cabin on a 50-foot steel tower; it is still staffed each summer.

access.note: Lookout Road (Forest Road 10103) runs to the summit. Camping near the tower needs permission from the staffed lookout.

visit.trail_note: Route is accessible by a high-clearance vehicle; no designated camping along the route.

events.note: Site possibly first established in 1918, per firelookout.com (possibly 1918) and a trail guide (initially established 1918).

corrections.why: 15.2 m is 50 feet, the height of the earlier steel tower. The present timber tower is 67 feet, about 20.4 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says developed in 1923 (possibly 1918). A trail guide says initially established in 1918 and the 1923 cabin replaced in 1961. The register dates the first cabin to 1923. The record uses 1923 for the first cabin and notes 1918 as possible.

notes_for_editor: The 1961 replacement, the 67-foot timber tower and the 2022 register date agree across sources; the brief's 15.2 m height is the earlier 50-foot steel tower, so a correction is proposed. Staffing comes from undated firelookout.com and trail-guide text, so the as_of date is the research date; a current staffing check would strengthen it. Access is restricted to the road and staffed-lookout permission; the sources do not say whether the tower itself is open to visitors, so climbable is omitted. Confidence is high on the build history and medium on current staffing.
